title: Arod
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
When you play Arod, you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, remove 2 [dwarven] tokens to prevent that.
lore: A smaller and lighter horse, but restive and fiery....
subtitle: Rohirrim Steed

title: Awkward Moment
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +3 (or +4 and damage +1 if you can spot a [dwarven] token).
lore: It's a long way.

title: Deep Hatred
gametext:
Each time the fellowship moves, add (2).
Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf who is not assigned to a skirmish to wound 2 Orcs (or to wound 1 Orc twice).
Discard this from play if the fellowship is ahead on the adventure path.
lore: ...the War of the Dwarves and the Orcs....

title: Dwarf-lords
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [dwarven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your Dwarf bearing a hand weapon strength +3.
lore: ...Seven for the Dwarf-lords in their halls of stone....

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Gimli is strength +1 for each minion assigned to a skirmish.
Assignment: Exert Gimli and spot a lurker minion to make that minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.
lore: 'He and his people did great works in Gondor and Rohan.'
subtitle: Lord of the Glittering Caves

title: Honoring His Kinfolk
gametext: If a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, play a [dwarven] possession from your discard pile and you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.
lore: ...but Gimli had to be dragged away by Legolas....

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce {dwarven} token

title: Sorrow Shared
gametext: Remove a [dwarven] token to heal a Dwarf.
lore: Gimli was saddened by Éowyn's despair.

title: Subterranean Homestead
gametext:
To play, exert 2 Dwarves.
When you play this, add a [dwarven] token here for each mountain site and each underground site on the adventure path.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a Shadow player discard the top card of his or her draw deck.

title: Arwen
gametext:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each of your other [elven] companions is resistance +1.
Skirmish: Exert Arwen to make a minion she is skirmishing strength -1 for each other companion assigned to a skirmish.
lore: 'Arwen vanimelda, namarië!'
subtitle: Reflection of Lúthien

title: Asfaloth
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
When you play Asfaloth, you may reinforce an [elven] token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [elven] tokens to heal bearer (or heal bearer and heal another Elf if bearer is in a fierce skirmish).
lore: '...my horse will not let any rider fall....'
subtitle: Swift Blossom

title: Celeborn
gametext:
While the fellowship is at a forest site, each Elf who has resistance 7 or more gains muster.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may take an [elven] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'I did not know that your plight was so evil.'
subtitle: The Wise

title: City of the Trees
gametext:
At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn.
At the start of each skirmish involving an Elf and a wounded minion, you may draw a card.
lore: Many stairs they climbed to meet the Galadhrim.

title: Crashing Cavalry
gametext: Assignment: Discard this from play and assign a minion to an [elven] companion. Those characters cannot use skirmish special abilities until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: At that moment there came a roaring and a rushing: a noise of loud waters rolling many stones.

title: Final Shot
gametext: Make an [elven] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn).
lore: Redoubling their efforts, the Company at last felled the Cave Troll.

title: Galadriel
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reveal a card from the top of your draw deck for each forest on the adventure path to heal an Elf for each [elven] card revealed.
lore: 'Do not let your hearts be troubled....'
subtitle: Sorceress of the Hidden Land

title: Inside a Song
gametext: Exert an Elf to take an [elven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile and you may reinforce an [elven] token.
lore: 'I thought that Elves were all for moon and stars; but this is more elvish than anything I ever heard tell of.'

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce {elven} token?

title: Kindreds Estranged
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [elven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make a minion skirmishing your Elf at a forest or river site strength -3.
lore: 'Men multiply and the Firstborn decrease....'

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
At the start of each archery phase, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, wound a minion.
lore: 'My heart bids me go on... but we must hold together. I will follow your counsel.'
subtitle: Of the Grey Company

title: Let Fly
gametext: Spot 3 Elves, spot a Shadow race, and choose a Shadow player to wound each of that player's minions which is not of that race.
lore: 'Yet I make my tale twenty at the least. But that is only a few leaves in a forest.'

cost.text: Choose a minion with a race that will be spared

title: Lórien Protector
gametext: While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.
lore: There was a sound of soft laughter over their heads, and then another clear voice spoke in an elven-tongue.

title: Many Miles
gametext: Spot 2 Elf archers to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if a Shadow player has replaced the fellowship's current site this turn).
lore: 'I can see a darkness. There are shapes moving in it, great shapes far away upon the bank of the river; but what they are I cannot tell.'

title: Secluded Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
When you play this, add an [elven] token here for each forest site and each river site on the adventure path.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to reconcile your hand.

title: Shrouded Elf
gametext: Response: If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.
lore: Cloaked by Elven garments and by darkness, warriors led by Haldir reinforced Helm's Deep.

title: Spring Forth Nimbly
gametext: Make an Elf strength +1 for each card that has an [elven] token on it.
lore: ...the Elf had no boots, but wore only light shoes, as he always did....

title: Standing Tall
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1 for each of the following that is true: it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or more; it is wounded; you can spot an Elf archer; the fellowship is at a forest site.
lore: Yrch,' said Legolas, falling into his own tongue.

title: Take Up the Bow
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Archery: Discard this from play and spot 3 Elf archers to discard a minion from play. Each of those archers loses archer and cannot gain archer.
lore: Stringing the bow and fitting an arrow....

title: Wells of Deep Memory
gametext:
At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card for each of the following you can spot: Arwen, Celeborn, or Galadriel.

title: Alatar
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token.
While you can spot a [gandalf] companion, each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1.
lore: Third of the Istari to be named, he was clad in sea-blue.
subtitle: Final Envoy

title: Dasron
gametext: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may remove 2 Free Peoples culture tokens to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: ...its inhabitants, traditional trading partners of Esgaroth and Dale, now look to their northern allies for protection against the wild Easterlings....
subtitle: Merchant From Dorwinion

title: Fear and Great Wonder
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gandalf] token here.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to spot a [gandalf] companion. That companion gains muster until end of turn.
lore: The Hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.

title: The Flame of Anor
gametext:
Spell.
Spot 3 [gandalf] companions to make a minion skirmishing a companion strength -3.
lore: The power of the flame is like that of the Sun – beautiful yet blinding.

title: For a While Less Dark
gametext:
Spell.
Make a [gandalf] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion bears a follower).
lore: The Nazgûl gave a long wailing cry and swerved away; and with that the four others waivered....

title: Gandalf
gametext: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 [gandalf] cards from hand.
lore: 'But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care.'
subtitle: Bearer of Obligation

title: Look to My Coming
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gandalf] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Spot Gandalf to make your [gandalf] companion strength +3.
lore: '...at dawn on the fifth day.'

title: No Colour Now
gametext: Discard your [gandalf] condition from play to discard a condition from play and draw a card.
lore: 'He raised his hand, and spoke slowly in a clear cold voice. 'Saruman, your staff is broken.'

title: The Palantír of Orthanc
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf. To play this, if you can spot The Palantír of Orthanc, discard it.
At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add a burden to reveal a Shadow player's hand. He or she must choose a revealed minion and discard it from hand.
lore: ...a heavy shining thing came hurtling down from above.
subtitle: Recovered Seeing Stone

title: Pallando
gametext:
Aid – (2).
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [gandalf] companion, exert bearer twice.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.
lore: Brought as a companion by Alatar, he traveled the South and East to aid the Free Peoples.
subtitle: Far-travelling One

title: Radagast
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)
While you can spot 2 [gandalf] companions, minions skirmishing bearer do not gain strength bonuses from possessions.
lore: 'It would have been useless in any case to try and win over the honest Radagast to treachery.'
subtitle: Tender of Beasts

title: Return to Us
gametext: Discard 2 Shadow cards from hand to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'Yes, that was the name. I was Gandalf.'

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
When you play Shadowfax, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [gandalf] tokens to wound a minion skirmishing bearer.
lore: Then Shadowfax gathered himself together and sprang away, and the night flowed over him....
subtitle: Roaring Wind

title: Strange Meeting
gametext: Each companion bearing a follower gains muster (and is strength +1 if that companion is a [gandalf] companion).
lore: 'Gandalf obviously expected to find Treebeard here; and Treebeard might almost have been loitering about near the gates on purpose to meet him.'

title: Traveler's Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot a Wizard.
When you play this, add X [gandalf] tokens here, where X is the current region number.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to discard a Shadow condition from play.
lore: Of the Wizards, it was Gandalf that chose no home.

title: Vapour and Steam
gametext: Skirmish: Exert your [gandalf] companion and add a burden to make that companion damage +1.
lore: 'There was none to see, or perhaps in after ages songs would still be sung of the Battle of the Peak.'

title: Chasm's Edge
gametext: Gollum is strength +1 for each Ring-bound companion you can spot.
lore: ...Gollum, dancing like a mad thing, held aloft the ring... It shown now as if verily it was wrought of living fire.

title: Cunningly Hidden
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [gollum] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Spot Gollum to make a minion strength +2.
lore: 'No one ever found out what had become of Déagol....'

title: Déagol
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Aid – Add a burden.
Skirmish: If bearer is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this from play to play an artifact or possession from your draw deck on bearer.
lore: '...there in his hand lay a beautiful golden ring.'
subtitle: Fateful Finder

title: Duality
gametext: Spot Sméagol to choose a Shadow player who must discard a Shadow card from hand or remove (2).
lore: Gollum had two loyalties: The Ring and The Ring.

texts: Discard a Shadow card from hand

title: Fishing Boat
gametext:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
When you play Fishing Boat, you may reinforce a [gollum] token.
Each time Sméagol is about to be overwhelmed in a skirmish, you may remove 2 [gollum] tokens to make him strength +2 until the end of that skirmish.

title: Gladden Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
When you play this, add a [gollum] token here for each [gollum] card you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to spot a Shadow condition and place that condition on top of its owner's draw deck.

title: Gollum
gametext:
While a card titled Déagol is removed from the game, Gollum is strength +2 and fierce.
Shadow: Remove a card titled Déagol in your discard pile from the game to play this minion from your discard pile.
lore: Of that deadly gleam and of the dark eyeholes Frodo and Sam were always conscious.
subtitle: Her Sneak

title: It's My Birthday
gametext: Make Gollum strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot Sméagol or Déagol).
lore: 'Give us that, Déagol, my love....'

title: Little Snuffler
gametext:
If the fellowship is in region 1, spot Gollum to wound a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 2, spot Gollum to exert a companion.
If the fellowship is in region 3, play a [gollum] minion from your discard pile.

title: Naked Waste
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gollum] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Spot Sméagol to make a Ring-bound companion strength +3.
lore: 'Nothing can hide from them. Curse the White Face!'

title: Out of All Knowledge
gametext: Spot Sméagol or exert Gollum to make Sméagol strength +2 and you may reinforce a [gollum] token.
lore: And he thought suddenly: "It would be cool and shady under those mountains. The Sun could not watch me there."'

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce a {gollum} token?

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
For each card titled Déagol in your discard pile, Sméagol is strength +2 and resistance -1.
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may take a [gollum] card from your draw deck and place it in your discard pile.
lore: '...his head and his eyes were downward.'
subtitle: Simple Stoor

title: Softly Up Behind
gametext:
Spot Sméagol and discard 2 [gollum] cards from hand to return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner's hand.
While this is in your discard pile, Sméagol gains muster.
lore: 'The Ring went into the shadows with him, and even the maker... could learn nothing of it.'

title: Trap Is Sprung
gametext:
To play, discard Gollum from play.
Heal the Ring-bearer to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on the Ring-bearer.
lore: 'Crumbs on his jacket. He took it. He took it!'

effect.text: Would you like to heal the Ring-beaer to add a burden?

title: Wild Light of Madness
gametext: Spot Gollum to make the Free Peoples player choose to either add a burden or exert a companion.
lore: ...for at that moment many things happened.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Aragorn is strength +1 for each [gondor] card that has a culture token on it.
At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: Thus came Aragorn, son of Arathorn, Elessar....
subtitle: Isildur's Heir

title: Away on the Wind
gametext: Response: If Faramir is about to take a wound, discard this condition from play and place Boromir or Denethor in the dead pile from play to prevent that and heal Faramir twice.
lore: '...then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated.'

title: Banners Blowing
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [gondor] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your [gondor] Man strength +3.
lore: And so... with less than six thousands... the Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate....

title: Boromir
gametext:
Boromir is resistance -1 for each lurker minion you can spot.
Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make him strength +1 for each possession he bears.
lore: 'I shall go to Minas Tirith, alone if need be, for it is my duty.'
subtitle: Doomed Heir

title: Brego
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] companion.
When you play Brego, you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
Maneuver: Exert bearer and remove 2 [gondor] tokens to wound a minion.
lore: 'Turn this fellow free. He has seen enough of war.'
subtitle: Loyal Steed

title: Denethor
gametext:
Denethor is resistance +1 for each [gondor] possession in your discard pile.
Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] possession borne by a companion and remove that possession from the game to exert a minion twice.
lore: ...he took up the staff of his Stewardship that lay at his feet and broke it on his knee.
subtitle: Last Ruling Steward

title: Elendil
gametext:
Knight. To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights or exert 2 [gondor] Men.
Each of your [gondor] companions is resistance +1.
Maneuver: Remove a [gondor] token to make an unbound companion resistance +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: '...and Elendil of Westernesse who overthrew Sauron....'
subtitle: High-king of Gondor

title: Faramir
gametext:
While you can spot Boromir, Faramir is twilight cost -1.
While you can spot Denethor, Faramir is twilight cost -1.
While Faramir bears a [gondor] possession, he is defender +1.
lore: 'Do you wish then... that our places had been exchanged?'
subtitle: Prince of Ithilien

title: Guard of the White Tree
gametext:
Knight.
Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] condition from your support area to make this companion strength +2.
lore: This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel....

title: Guarded City
gametext: Spot a [gondor] companion to reinforce a [gondor] token for each possession borne by that companion.
lore: ...so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded but carven by giants out of the bones of the earth.

title: Heirs of Gondor
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gondor] token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [gondor] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2.
lore: 'And Eldarion our son is a man full-ripe for kingship.'

title: Hope Renewed
gametext: Discard a [gondor] possession from play to discard a possession from play and you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
lore: '...Frodo saw the old king's head: it was lying rolled away by the roadside... 'Look! The king has got a crown again!'

effect.text: Would you like to reinforce a {gondor} token

title: Isildur
gametext:
Knight.
Isildur is resistance +1 for each card in your hand.
At the end of any phase, if Isildur has resistance 0, place him in your dead pile.
Each time you reconcile, you may draw a card.
lore: '...Elendil's son cut the Ring from Sauron's hand....'
subtitle: Heir of Elendil

title: Kings' Legacy
gametext:
Each time Elendil wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] or [elven] companion strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.
Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a Man.
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] Man damage +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Kingsfoil
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Fellowship: Discard this possession from play to heal a companion and, if that companion is a [shire] companion, you may discard a condition he or she bears.
lore: 'Life to the dying / In the king's hand lying!'

title: Rally the Company
gametext: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion has resistance 6 or more).
lore: Aragorn was able to keep the way open for escape from the Chamber of Mazarbul.

title: Stewards' Legacy
gametext:
Each time Denethor exerts, he gains muster until the end of the regroup phase.
Each time Boromir exerts, you may exert a minion.
Each time Faramir exerts, you may spot a minion to prevent it from using special abilities until the regroup phase.

title: Storied Homestead
gametext:
When you play this, add a [gondor] token here for each [gondor] companion who has resistance 7 or more.
Response: If a minion's special ability is used, discard this condition or remove 2 [gondor] tokens from here to cancel its effect.
lore: ...a silent company of tall images graven in cold stone.

title: Tradesman From Lebennin
gametext: At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to reinforce a [gondor] token.
lore: Fearful of the spreading Shadow, many from southern Gondor sought refuge behind the walls of Minas Tirith.

title: Alatar Deceived
gametext: Each time a Wizard wins a skirmish, this condition becomes a fierce, damage +1 Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 11 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
lore: '...the world of Men, which We must rule.'

title: Pallando Deceived
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a Wizard to make this condition a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
lore: 'We may join with that Power.'

title: Radagast Deceived
gametext: Each time a Wizard heals, this condition becomes a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 12 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
lore: 'Radagast the Simple! Radagast the Fool!'

title: Staff of Saruman
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
Regroup: If Saruman is the only minion you can spot, discard this artifact from play to return him to your hand.
lore: He raised his staff and it engulfed Gandalf in flames.
subtitle: Fallen Istar's Stave

title: Bring Down the Wall
gametext: Spot a companion to make a [men] minion strength +1 for each wound on that companion.
lore: 'Helm's Deep has one weakness. Its outer wall is solid rock but for a small culvert at its base, which is little more than a drain.'

title: Caravan From the South
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
When you play this, if you spot a plains site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [men] tokens.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship's next site, you may discard a possession from play.

title: Corsair Champion
gametext:
Each time a Free Peoples possession is played, you may spot a [men] card and reveal this minion from hand to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
lore: Rumor of his approach strikes terror.

title: Cruel Dunlending
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Burning with a rage stoked by Saruman, the Wild Hillmen made the Rohirrim villagers suffer.

title: Desert Wind
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
While you can spot 5 or more culture tokens, the minion archery total is +2.
lore: Silent Haradrim assassins strike as if from nowhere.

title: Driven From the Plains
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a [men] minion damage +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a plains site; it is bearing a possession; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lore: The Hillmen sent the villagers before them like lambs to the slaughter.

title: Dunlending Patriarch
gametext:
When you play this, you may spot another [men] minion to make this minion twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
lore: The wisdom of Dunland is passed from elder to youth.

title: Dunlending Trapper
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
To play, spot a [men] minion.
Assignment: Discard a [men] card from your hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
lore: His traps catch men as well as beasts.

title: Easterling Runner
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion, spot another [men] minion, and remove a culture token to reinforce a [men] token.
lore: The key to coordinating the columns of the Easterling army is their use of swift couriers.

title: Fires Brightly Burning
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [men] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [men] minion strength +2.
lore: The torches of hate carried by the Dunlendings were kindled by the voice of Saruman.

title: Gríma
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, you may spot another [men] minion to exert each companion.
lore: 'He was crafty: dulling men's wariness, or working on their fears, as served the occasion.'
subtitle: Footman of Saruman

title: Harmless
gametext:
Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, transfer this condition from your support area to that companion. Limit 1 per companion.
Minions cannot take wounds during skirmishes involving bearer.
lore: The Dunlendings prey on weak village folk.

title: Howdah
gametext:
When you play this, add a [men] token here for each [men] archer you spot.
At the start of the archery phase, you may discard this condition from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make the minion archery total +1.
lore: Wooden towers perched on the backs of the Mûmakil.

title: Lying in Wait
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to your [men] minion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Bearer is strength +1 for each other [men] minion you can spot.
Each time a [men] minion wins a skirmish, make bearer strength +1 until the regroup phase.

title: Merciless Dunlending
gametext: While you can spot another [men] minion, this minion is strength +2 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Victims of the Dunlendings receive no quarter.

title: Pirate Cutthroat
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] card in your support area.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to reinforce a [men] token for each card you spot that has the same card title as that condition.
lore: Prisoners are never taken by the Corsairs of Umbar.

title: Southron Murderer
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot 4 or more culture tokens, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.
lore: In Harad, death is often swift, but seldom painless.

title: Stragglers
gametext:
When you play this, add a [men] token here.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [men] minion strength +2 for each [men] minion not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: When finished ransacking a homestead, Dunlendings slaughtered fleeing villagers.

title: Vicious Dunlending
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion damage +1.
lore: A swath of terror cut across the fields of Rohan.

title: Voice of the Desert
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, each [men] minion cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, each [men] minion is an archer.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each [men] minion is fierce.
subtitle: Southron Troop

title: Worn Battleaxe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
While you can spot a culture token, bearer is strength +1 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Arms of the Hillmen of Dunland are crude but effective.

title: Always Threatening
gametext:
When you play this, you may add an [orc] token here for each [orc] condition you can spot.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a lurker minion strength +2.

title: Chamber Patrol
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, [orc] Orcs cannot take wounds.
While the fellowship is in region 2, the current site gains underground.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each [orc] Orc is strength +2.

title: Defiled
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [orc] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [orc] lurker minion strength +2.
lore: ...transmogrified to trophies by the advancing hordes.

title: Enemy Upon Enemy
gametext:
Regroup: Spot an [orc] lurker minion to stack that minion here.
Shadow: Remove a burden to play a lurker minion stacked here as if from hand. That minion is twilight cost -3.
lore: On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached.

title: Expendable Servants
gametext: If you can spot more [orc] conditions than [orc] minions, you may discard your [orc] condition from play to play an [orc] minion from your discard pile.
lore: Sauron's minions were loyal to his rule. Their loyalty was repaid in blood: the enemy's or their own.

title: Forced March
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [orc] minions.
Regroup: Make the Free Peoples player spot another [orc] condition, discard it from play, and remove (3) to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows). Discard this condition.
lore: Orcs do not rest.

title: Howling Orc
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time an [orc] minion is killed in a skirmish, you may make this minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: Losses served only to enrage the besiegers.

title: Isengard Informant
gametext: Regroup: Exert this minion to play an [orc] Troll from your discard pile.
lore: Some remained in Isengard to propel the war machine.

title: Massing Strength
gametext: Discard any number of your [orc] minions from play to make an [orc] minion strength +3 for each one discarded.
lore: ...the Dark Power, moving its armies like pieces on the board, was gathering them together.

title: Orc Crusher
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden.
Each time a Ring-bound companion loses a skirmish involving an [orc] minion, you may reveal this card from hand to add a burden.
lore: 'Hit me now, Sam. Hit me!'

title: Orc Line-breaker
gametext: At the end of each skirmish involving this minion, if you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Fell captains moved Sauron's forces from the Gorgoroth plains.

title: Orc Plains Runner
gametext: Regroup: Discard this minion from play (or exert this minion if the fellowship's next site is an underground site) and spot another [orc] minion to return that minion to your hand.
lore: Saruman unleashed the remaining minions to ravage the countryside of Rohan.

title: Orc Raid Commander
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] card in your support area.
When you play this, spot a Free Peoples condition to discard from play each other card that has the same card title as that condition.
lore: Once inside the walls of the City, the besiegers were ordered to kill on sight.

title: Orc Reaper
gametext: While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, each minion that has the title Orc Reaper is strength +2.
lore: As they overrun the lands of the Free Peoples, the forces of the Shadow destroy all available resources.

title: Ordnance Grunt
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Shadow: Discard an [orc] condition from play to play this minion from your discard pile.
lore: Only Trolls had the strength to man the siege catapults.

title: Picket Denizen
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If another [orc] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that.
lore: Frontline minions drew the fire of parapet archers.

title: Underdeeps Denizen
gametext: While this minion is at an underground site, it cannot take wounds.
lore: There was a crash on the door, followed by crash after crash.... How many there were the Company could not count.

title: Unforgiving Depths
gametext:
While you can spot 3 underground sites, each [orc] Orc gains muster.
Shadow: Discard this condition from play and spot an [orc] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.

title: Whatever Means
gametext: Make an [orc] Orc strength +2 (or +6 if you remove 2 burdens).
lore: The besiegers believed not that the flames would burn the city walls, but the souls of those behind them.

effect.text: Would you like to remove 2 burdens to add +4 more strength?

title: Bitter Tidings
gametext:
If Théoden is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Théodred to prevent that.
If Théodred is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Éowyn to prevent that.
lore: Théodred my son is slain.'

effects.text: Discard Éomer or Théodred to prevent wound to Théoden
Discard Éomer or Éowyn to prevent wound to Théodred

title: Éomer
gametext:
While Éomer bears a mount, he is damage +1.
While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +1 for each other [rohan] companion you can spot.
lore: 'I have no child. Théodred my son is slain. I name Éomer my sister-son to be my heir.'
subtitle: Heir to Meduseld

title: Éowyn
gametext:
Each possession you play on Éowyn during the fellowship phase is twilight cost -1.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reinforce a [rohan] token (or reinforce 2 [rohan] tokens if you can spot Éomer or Théoden).
lore: 'Let her be as lord to the Eorlingas, while we are gone.'
subtitle: Restless Warrior

title: Ferthu Théoden Hal
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men.
Unless you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, discard a possession from play.
lore: 'Receive now this cup and drink in happy hour.'

title: Firefoot
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
When you play Firefoot, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
At the start of the maneuver phase, if bearer is Éomer, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to make him defender +1 and strength +1 until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Mearas of The Mark

title: Freely Across Our Land
gametext:
When you play this, add a [rohan] token here.
Regroup: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile on your [rohan] companion.
lore: Unchecked, unchallenged, killing at will!

title: Háma
gametext:
Háma is strength +1 for each Shadow possession you can spot.
Each time Háma wins a skirmish, you may discard a possession from play.
lore: 'Do not hope too much! These are dark days.'
subtitle: Captain of the King's Guard

title: Hamstrung
gametext: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved twice this turn).
lore: Spears and arrows from Rohan brought down the mighty Mûmakil.

title: Hurried Barrows
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [rohan] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your mounted [rohan] companion strength +3.
lore: The fallen sleep with honor.

title: King's Board
gametext:
Skirmish: Exert Éomer to make Éowyn or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to make Éomer or Théoden strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Théoden to make Éomer or Éowyn strength +2.
lore: Also wakened in Edoras was hospitality.

effects.text: Exert Éomer to make Éowyn or Théoden strength +2
Exert Éowyn to make Éomer or Théoden strength +2
Exert Théoden to make Éomer or Éowyn strength +2

title: Merchant of Westfold
gametext: Each time the fellowship moves, you may add (1) and remove a Free Peoples culture token to reinforce a [rohan] token.
lore: Villagers from the surrounding farmlands fled to Helm's Deep seeking safety.

title: Riddermark Tactician
gametext:
When you play this, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
Each time a Shadow player replaces the fellowship's current site, you may spot another [rohan] Man to make, until the regroup phase, the fellowship archery total +2 and the minion archery total -2.

title: Ride With Me
gametext: Make your [rohan] companion strength +2 (or exert Théoden to make that companion strength +5 and damage +1 instead).
lore: Maybe we shall cleave a road, or make such an end as will be worth a song – if any be left to sing of us hereafter.'

true.text: Would you like to exert Théoden to add +3 strength and damage +1?

title: Rider's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.
lore: Riders of the Mark carried short bows easily fired from horseback.

title: Snowmane
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
When you play Snowmane, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
Skirmish: If bearer is Théoden, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to exhaust a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: 'Where now the horse and the rider?'
subtitle: Noble Mearas

title: Théoden
gametext:
While you can spot Éowyn, Théoden is defender +1.
While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1.
While you can spot Théodred, the move limit is +1.
lore: 'Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!'
subtitle: The Renowned

title: Théodred
gametext:
While you can spot a [rohan] Man who has resistance of 7 or more, Théodred is twilight cost -1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Théodred, you may exert each minion he is skirmishing.
lore: The son of Théoden defended Rohan at the Fords of Isen.
subtitle: Second Marshal of the Mark

title: Wind-swept Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] companions.
When you play this, add a [rohan] token here for each plains site and each battleground site on the adventure path.
At the start of each regroup phase, add a [rohan] token here for each of your companions that has muster.

title: Sauron
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce.
When you play Sauron, you may exert any number of minions. For each minion you exert, Sauron is twilight cost -X, where X is the current region number.
lore: '...the Shadow grows once more....'
subtitle: Dark Lord of Mordor

title: Sceptre of the Dark Lord
gametext:
Bearer must be Sauron.
He is damage +1.
Each time Sauron wins a skirmish and the companion he is skirmishing is not killed, you may assign X wounds to other companions, where X is the current region number.

title: Bilbo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
While Bilbo is not assigned to a skirmish, each Ring-bound Hobbit is strength +1.
At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may remove a burden for each other Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
lore: '...I am quite ready to go on another journey....'
subtitle: Aged Ring-bearer

title: Bill the Pony
gametext:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
When you play Bill the Pony, you may reinforce a [shire] token.
Regroup: Spot 2 minions and remove 2 [shire] tokens to make a Shadow player discard a minion from play.
lore: Sam would not go to bed until he had visited Bill....
subtitle: Dearly-loved

title: Daddy Twofoot
gametext:
Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may take a [shire] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'That's a dark bad place, if half the tales be true.'
subtitle: Next-door Neighbor

title: Don't Let Go
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Hobbit strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is participating in a fierce skirmish; he or she has resistance 7 or more; he or she is at a dwelling site; you can spot an unwounded Hobbit.
lore: 'Don't you give up on me Mr. Frodo!'

title: Everything but My Bones
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 other [shire] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game.
Make your Hobbit at a dwelling or forest site strength +3.
lore: ...I'll carry Mr. Frodo up myself....'

title: Faith in Friendship
gametext:
When you play this, add a [shire] token here.
At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this from play or remove a token from here to heal a [shire] companion.
lore: I'm going to take care of you.

title: Fates Entwined
gametext: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may heal another Hobbit once (or heal another Hobbit twice if the Hobbit that won the skirmish was Frodo or Bilbo).
lore: 'Yes, I am coming... The Ring-bearers should go together.'

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bound.
While you can spot more minions than companions, Frodo cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
Skirmish: If Frodo is not assigned to a skirmish, exert Frodo to have him replace a Ring-bound companion skirmishing a minion.
subtitle: Frenzied Fighter

title: Frodo Gamgee
gametext:
Aid – Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot a Ring-bound Hobbit.
Bearer is strength +1 for each Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
lore: '...Rose and me had settled to call him Frodo, with your leave....'
subtitle: Son of Samwise

title: The Gaffer
gametext:
Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
When you transfer The Gaffer to a [shire] companion, heal bearer (or heal bearer twice if he or she is at a dwelling site).
lore: ...the Gaffer was recognized as the leading authority....
subtitle: Master Gardener

title: Humble Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
When you play this, add a [shire] token here for each forest site and each dwelling site on the adventure path.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 3 tokens from here to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit.

title: Mithril-coat
gametext:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make each minion he is skirmishing lose fierce and unable to gain fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: '...cold as ice, and harder than steel.'
subtitle: Dwarf-mail

title: New Chapter
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time you play a follower, you may heal a companion (or heal Sam twice).
lore: And so it was settled. Sam Gamgee married Rosie Cotton in the spring of 1420....

title: Phial of Galadriel
gametext:
Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.
While bearer is in region 1, bearer gains muster.
While bearer is in region 2, each of your [shire] companions gains muster.
While bearer is in region 3, each character gains muster.
subtitle: The Light of Eärendil

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Sam is resistance +1 for each Hobbit you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Sam and transfer a follower he is bearing to your support area to discard a minion from play.
lore: '...the last of all the Company. The errand must not fail.'
subtitle: Bearer of Great Need

title: Westfarthing Businessman
gametext: This companion is strength +1 for each [shire] card that has a culture token on it.
lore: 'There's a tidy bit of money tucked away up there, I hear tell....'

title: Assault Commander
gametext:
Damage +1.
Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to make an unbound companion resistance -1 for each card that has the same card title as that condition.
lore: Fear is a potent weapon in the hands of an Uruk-hai.

title: Assault Denizen
gametext:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture token you can spot.
lore: Theories and tactics of warfare were tested upon the battlefields of Middle-earth.

title: Cavern Denizen
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.
lore: Saruman uses the enemy's strength to his own advantage.

title: Endless Assault
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a battleground site; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; it is bearing a possession; you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion not assigned to a skirmish.

title: Enemy Without Number
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [uruk-hai] minions.
Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to add (1).
Regroup: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion and discard this condition from play to add (3).
lore: Valour could not prevent the breach of the Deeping Wall.

title: Entranced Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Possessions borne by this minion cannot be discarded by Free Peoples cards.
lore: An Uruk is disarmed only when it hurls its weapon.

title: Fearless Approach
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.
When you play this, if you spot a battleground site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [uruk-hai] tokens.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship's next site, you may discard a condition from play.

title: Isengard Infiltrator
gametext:
Damage +1.
While the fellowship is at a forest site, the fellowship archery total is -1.
Each [elven] companion skirmishing this minion is strength -2.
lore: The Uruk-hai trained to engage the enemy in its own territory.

title: New Enemy
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [uruk-hai] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your [uruk-hai] minion skirmishing a companion with resistance 4 or less strength +2.
lore: ...goblin-soldiers of greater stature.

title: Signs of War
gametext: While you can spot 3 [uruk-hai] lurker minions, at the start of each skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] lurker minion, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.
lore: Horsemen were galloping on the grass of Rohan; wolves poured from Isengard.

title: Uruk Aggressor
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this, you may spot a companion who has resistance 0 to make this minion twilight cost -2.
lore: The defenses of the Hornburg were exploited, exposing their weakest points.

title: Uruk Blitz
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.
While the fellowship is in region 1, each Uruk-hai is damage +1.
While the fellowship is in region 2, each companion is strength -1.
While the fellowship is in region 3, each unbound companion is resistance -2.

title: Uruk Distractor
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a companion skirmishing another [uruk-hai] minion.
lore: Wounds do not always remove the Uruk-hai from their assault.

title: Uruk Invader
gametext:
Damage +1.
This minion is twilight cost -1 for each companion who has resistance 2 or less.
lore: To sense weakness is to assume victory.

title: Uruk Outrider
gametext: This minion is damage +1 for each character in the dead pile.
lore: The lesser the enemy, the greater the rage.

title: Uruk Reserve
gametext:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time your [uruk-hai] minion is about to be killed in a skirmish, you may place that minion on the bottom of your draw deck instead.

title: Uruk Rogue
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: If no other minions are assigned to a skirmish, exert this minion twice to make it fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.
lore: Some minions prefer to fight alone.

title: Uruk Tactician
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] lurker minion strength -2.
lore: Select warriors had been tasked with advancing the assault beyond the Deeping Wall.

title: War Machine
gametext: Exert your [uruk-hai] lurker minion to play an [uruk-hai] hand weapon from your discard pile on your [uruk-hai] minion.
lore: ...on the front of their iron helms was set an S-rune, wrought of some white metal.

title: Weapons of Control
gametext:
When you play this, add an [uruk-hai] token here for each wounded companion.
Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] minion strength -1.

title: Dark Fell About Him
gametext:
To play, exert your Nazgûl twice and spot an exhausted companion.
Heal that companion to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on that companion.
lore: Men cast from the saddle lay grovelling on the ground.

effect.text: Would you like to heal {exhaustedCompanion} to add a burden?

title: From Hideous Eyrie
gametext:
You may remove from the game 4 [wraith] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card.
Make your Nazgûl in a fierce skirmish strength +2.
lore: Down, down it came, and then, folding its fingered webs, it gave a croaking cry....

title: Shadow in the East
gametext:
Toil 1. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
To play, spot a [wraith] card in your support area.
Spot a companion to draw a card for each wound on that companion (and draw an additional card if you can spot a Nazgûl).
lore: '...it is called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery.'

title: They Came From Mordor
gametext:
When you play this, you may add a [wraith] token here for each [wraith] card in your support area.
Shadow: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to play a [wraith] mount from your draw deck on your [wraith] minion.
lore: 'That is the worst news that has come to Bree....'

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Enquëa, if you can spot 2 other Nazgûl, you may exert 2 unbound companions (or exert each companion if you can spot 6 companions).
lore: 'It is many a year since the Nine walked abroad.'
subtitle: Sixth of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Úlairë Lemenya and discard a Nazgûl from your hand to discard a condition from play.
lore: 'As the Shadow grows once more, they too may walk again.'
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, Úlairë Nertëa is twilight cost -2.
lore: From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffling to catch an elusive scent....
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow

title: Abandoned Mine Shaft
gametext: Underground. If this site is not in region 1 when the fellowship moves from here during the regroup phase, add a burden.

title: Caves of Aglarond
gametext: Underground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may remove 2 burdens.

title: City of Kings
gametext: Battleground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may draw a card.

title: Courtyard Parapet
gametext: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the first Shadow player may discard 2 cards from hand to add a burden.

title: Crossroads of the Fallen Kings
gametext: Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may heal a companion of each culture.

title: Doors of Durin
gametext: Marsh. Each companion of each race that has the most companions is strength -1.

title: Fords of Isen
gametext: River. Each character is strength +1 for each card borne by that character.

title: The Great Gates
gametext: Battleground. While a player can spot more companions than minions, each minion is strength +1.

title: Isenwash
gametext: Battleground. Plains. At the start of the regroup phase, each Shadow player may exert a minion to exert a companion.

title: Redhorn Pass
gametext: Mountain. Culture tokens cannot be added, removed, or reinforced.
